messages:
Alex: Flagging a P1 from support -> CS. Trial org ClearPath seeing consistent 502s on embeddings since ~02:00 PST. Support tried restarts, errors persist. Need CS comms + enablement prep.
Maya: Ack. Can you drop sample log and last known-good time?
Alex: Last success 01:58. Fail at 02:03. Log: ```ERROR embed-service: upstream 502 model=ada-060 trace=tx-9ab3 err=\"kv cache miss + timeout\"```
Alex: Repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeds -d '{\"model\":\"ada-060\",\"input\":\"test\"}' -> 502 from prod-pool-A. INF-1142 opened.
oncall-bot: [alert] embed-service 5xx spike (prod-pool-A) - 87 errors / 5m.
Maya: Sam, please join for an enablement/comms plan. Devon FYI on renewal risk (trial ends in 5 days).
Sam: Quick ops Q: did support try switching traffic to pool-B or only restarts? If not, suggest temp routing + notify customer.
Alex: Only restarts and lane failover. Can route to pool-B but need CS OK to notify.
Devon: Renewal-risk: if outage >6h mark as renewal-watch and prep SE intro + 1-week free dedicated slot offer if SLA impacted.
Maya: Proposed short comm: 1) Ack <30m: we9re investigating 2) 1h update w/ mitigation (pool switch + ETA) 3) Post-fix RCA + offer enablement. Draft: "We9re investigating intermittent 502s affecting your trial embeddings; mitigation underway and we9ll update within 1 hour."
Sam: Playbook: - route to pool-B - monitor error rate on dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/prod-pool-A - increase KV cache TTL to 30s for tenant - enable verbose tracing for 1h
Alex: Executing pool-B switch now, will add trace header to repro.
Maya: Please draft ack and I9ll send. Schedule 30m sync with SE if needed; propose 14:30 PST.
Alex: Draft ack: "Hi team 5; we9re aware of intermittent 502s on embeddings; routing you to alternate capacity and will confirm when stable. Update in 1 hour. 5 Support" :thumbsup:
Maya: Shortened: "Hi 5; we9re aware of intermittent 502s on embeddings for your trial. We9re routing your requests to alternate capacity now and will confirm when stable. We9ll follow with an RCA and an optional enablement call. 5 Customer Success"
Sam: After switch verify 10 consecutive 200s and keep verbose traces for 30m. If errors persist escalate to runtime eng.
Alex: Pool-B switch executed at 2951234570. Initial: 18/20 OK, 2 transient 502s. Monitoring.
oncall-bot: [incident-update] INF-1142 mitigation applied (route-switch) at 2951234570
Devon: Maya, send ack, tag CRM as renewal-watch, and schedule postmortem + enablement session before renewal.
Maya: Sent ack to ClearPath at 2951234575 and posted copy here.
Maya: Actions: Alex (monitor & escalate if >5% errors), Sam (verify logs & KV TTL), Devon (renewal play + CRM tag), Maya (comm + schedule call).
Alex: Error rate down to 0.8% over last 10m. Will escalate if rises.
Sam: If customer accepts enablement call, include SE + CS + Support. Agenda: 1) what happened 2) best practices 3) next steps.
Maya: Thanks. I9ll send meeting invite and draft RCA. Closing criteria: <0.5% error for 30m. :eyes:
